edges.reason: Constructor assigns owner = tx.origin, so ownership depends on an untrusted transaction origin.
Constructor grants an infinite allowance to tx.origin on the pair.
list builds the router deadline as block.timestamp + 600, a miner-influenced value.
delegate requires msg.sender == owner before executing arbitrary code.
list requires msg.sender == owner before rewriting supply and balances.
transferFrom checks and decrements allowance[_from][msg.sender] using the caller.
transfer delegates execution to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
The checkBots modifier performs the low-level botProtection call.
The external call in the modifier executes before balanceOf and allowance are updated in transferFrom.
checkBots wraps transferFrom and makes an external call before the function body runs.
delegate executes an arbitrary delegatecall controlled by the owner-controlled arguments.
list performs a low-level call to botProtection with an owner-supplied address array.
The low-level call in list is made to an untrusted address and its result is ignored, allowing re-entry into transferFrom.
addLiquidityETH on the router calls back into the token transferFrom while list is still executing.
list forwards msg.value to uniRouter.addLiquidityETH.
Caller-controlled _value feeds the unchecked subtraction of allowance and balanceOf.
Unchecked subtraction writes allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value.
Unchecked subtraction and addition rewrite balanceOf[_from] and balanceOf[_to] without SafeMath.
transferFrom performs raw arithmetic under Solidity 0.7.0 instead of using SafeMath.
transferFrom reads and writes the balanceOf mapping.
transferFrom reads and writes the allowance mapping.
list overwrites balanceOf entries from owner-supplied arrays.
list computes the owner balance as totalSupply * 6 / 100.
Constructor assigns the owner state variable.

Constructor calls pairForPancake to derive the pair address.
wrappedEther is passed as one of the tokens to pairForPancake.

CryptionNetworkToken constructor invokes the BotProtected constructor.
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender].

list calls the botProtection address directly.
